reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for a resizable split-screen side chat with independent model settings, parent-context linkage, and compact conversation navigation.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供可调整大小的分屏侧边聊天、独立模型设置、主会话关联和紧凑的对话导航。
summaries.en: Adds a resizable split-screen side chat to DeepSeek Harness Web with independent model settings, parent-session context, and compact conversation navigation.

capabilities: Creates and manages child chat sessions
Persists side-chat relationship metadata, titles, and summaries
Provides model and reasoning-effort selection per side chat
Uses a private local loopback RPC channel
Renders messages, tool activity, approvals, questions, and command events
